rationale: The literal message "no almoço de 2026-10-05 comi arroz" explicitly describes food consumption/addition in a dated named meal. Its destination is expressed in leading position. ADR §7.1 requires operation, target meal, and date to remain separated from the food identity; issue #1278 independently documents the production bug in which the meal destination is parsed into the food item, and issue #1271 verifies dated target-meal semantics. Preserve the explicit destination/date and food identity without turning the meal label into food; add operation applies only once. Do not invent nutritional values or provenance, and do not claim resolver or webhook runtime behavior was executed. This is reference-semantic review.
